title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH (6,600 affected)
summary: AN OUT-OF-SPECIFICATION CONDITION IN THE SEAT CABLE ROLLER PULLEY ASSEMBLY CAN ALLOW THE CABLE THAT CONNECTS THE SEAT ADJUST LEVER TO THE LATCH TO BE PINCHED IN THE ROLLER ASSEMBLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING:U-BOLT (105 affected)
summary: ONE OF THE FOUR REAR AXLE U-BOLTS CAN BREAK. THIS CAN POTENTIALLY LEAD TO THE SPRING LIFTING FROM THE AXLE UNDER CERTAIN REBOUND, BRAKING OR CORNERING MANEUVERS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (2,740 affected)
summary: THE SUPPLEMENTARY AIR BAG INFLATABLE RESTRAINT CAUTION LABEL LOCATED ON THE DRIVER SIDE SUN VISOR DOES NOT CONTAIN THE STATEMENT, "DO NOT INSTALL REARWARD FACING CHILD SEATS IN ANY FRONT PASSENGER SEAT POSITION."   THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH (2,000 affected)
summary: AN OUT-OF-SPECIFICATION CONDITION IN THE SEAT CABLE ROLLER PULLEY ASSEMBLY CAN ALLOW THE CABLE THAT CONNECTS THE SEAT ADJUST LEVER TO THE LATCH TO BE PINCHED IN THE ROLLER ASSEMBLY.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/HANDRAILS (3,382 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.  PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (588 affected)
summary: THE AXLE HOUSINGS WERE MANUFACTURED WITH A TIGHT FRICTION WELD CURL RADIUS ON THE INSIDE DIAMETER OF THE AXLE HOUSING. UNDER OPERATIONAL LOADS, CRACKS CAN INITIATE AT THE WELD CURL RADIUS ON THE INSIDE OF THE HOUSING. THESE CRACKS MAY PROPAGATE, EVENTUALLY ALLOWING THE AXLE SPINDLE TO SEPARATE FROM THE AXLE HOUSING.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: TOYOTA/EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (15,707 affected)
summary: THE STICKER REQUIRED BY PART 575, "CONSUMER INFORMATION REGULATIONS" TO ALERT THE DRIVER OF "THE PARTICULAR HANDLING AND MANEUVERING CHARACTERISTICS OF UTILITY VEHICLES" WAS NOT AFFIXED TO THE DRIVER'S SIDE SUN VISOR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/STEERING RACK AND PINION MOUNT (140,000 affected)
summary: THE FRAME CAN CRACK AT THE STEERING GEAR ATTACHMENT AND/OR THE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BOLTS CAN FRACTURE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (321,000 affected)
summary: THE ABS HYDRAULIC CONTROL UNIT CAN EXPERIENCE EXCESSIVE BRAKE ACTUATOR PISTON SEAL WEAR CAUSING PUMP-MOTOR DETERIORATION.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY/BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:MOTORCYCLES (251 affected)
summary: THE SEAL ON THE REAR MASTER CYLINDER PISTON CAN MOVE OUT OF POSITION.

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (2,002 affected)
summary: TENT CAMPERS EQUIPPED WITH OPTIONAL REMOVABLE STEP.  THE REMOVABLE STEP CAN BREAK OFF AT THE ARMS WHICH ATTACH THE STEP TO THE UNIT.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (6,358 affected)
summary: AN ITEM WORN BY A CHILD, SUCH AS A LONG DRAWSTRING, SASH, OR BACKPACK/BOOKBAG ACCESSORY CAN BECOME CAUGHT IN A SMALL OPENING AT THE FLOOR LEVEL OF THE FORWARD DOOR POST.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS (325 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM CAN INTERFERE WITH THE MAIN CAB DASH HARNESS WHICH PASSES BEHIND THE CENTER DASH SECTION. THE WIPER ARM CAN WEAR THROUGH ONE OR MORE OF THE WIRES IN THE HARNESS AND CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: PIERCE/BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:VALVE (35 affected)
summary: THE DOUBLE CHECK VALVE INSTALLED ON THESE VEHICLES CAN FAIL ALLOWING FRONT BRAKE AIR TO BE EXHAUSTED OUT DURING BRAKE APPLICATION.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:CHECK VALVE (160,689 affected)
summary: A SOAPY LUBRICANT WAS USED TO INSERT THE CHECK VALVE INTO THE VACUUM HOSE WHICH CAUSES THE BRAKE BOOSTER CHECK VALVE TO STICK.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FLEETWOOD/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE (881 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRIC WIRE USED TO POWER THE EXPANDABLE ROOM HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR WAS NOT EQUIPPED WITH A CIRCUIT BREAKER. OVERHEATING OF THE WIRE CAN OCCUR WITH INCORRECT EXPANDABLE ROOM OPERATION.

title: Q/STRAINT: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (111,000 affected)
summary: THE BUSHING ON THE RIVET PIN IS CRACKED OR MISSING.

title: Land Rover: LAND ROVER/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART (4,254 affected)
summary: THE "HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCE LABEL" WARNING WAS NOT INSTALLED ON THE BATTERIES IN THESE VEHICLES.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: GM/TOYOTA/PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (627,858 affected)
summary: IF LIQUID IS SPILLED IN THE CONSOLE BOX AREA, THE AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT CAN ILLUMINATE AND STAY "ON" DURING NORMAL DRIVING CONDITIONS.

title: MOOG AUTOMOTIVE: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (94 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET BALL JOINT/CONTROL ARM MANUFACTURED BY MOOG INDUSTRIES.  DUE TO MISPACKAGING, CERTAIN BALL JOINT/CONTROL ARM ASSEMBLIES WERE INCORRECTLY PLACED IN THE WRONG BOXES.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR (350 affected)
summary: THE ELR/ALR FEATURE IS USED TO ACCOMMODATE CHILD RESTRAINTS. WHEN SERVICING THE REAR BELT ASSEMBLIES, WRONG PARTS COULD HAVE BEEN USED WHICH DO NOT CONTAIN THE AUTOMATIC LOCKING FEATURE.

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (376,000 affected)
summary: DUE TO MISASSEMBLY OF THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES, THE BUCKLES CAN RELEASE UPON IMPACT.

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (376,000 affected)
summary: DUE TO MISASSEMBLY OF THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES, THE BUCKLES CAN RELEASE UPON IMPACT.
